commands.label: backup-and-write-light-claude-desktop-config
commands.note: Backup current config then write lean config with only desktop-commander + filesystem
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$src='%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json'; $bak='%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config_full_backup_20261029.json'; Copy-Item $src $bak -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $lean='{\"mcpServers\":{\"desktop-commander\":{\"command\":\"npx\",\"args\":[\"@wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest\"]},\"filesystem\":{\"command\":\"npx\",\"args\":[\"-y\",\"@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem\",\"C:\\\\Users\\\\endos\\\\Desktop\\\\hst_work\",\"C:\\\\Users\\\\endos\\\\Desktop\\\\hst_out\",\"C:\\\\Users\\\\endos\\\\Desktop\\\\mt4_tester\",\"C:\\\\Users\\\\endos\\\\Desktop\\\\mt4_tester2\",\"C:\\\\Users\\\\endos\\\\Downloads\",\"C:\\\\Users\\\\endos\\\\Signal\",\"C:\\\\Users\\\\endos\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\MetaQuotes\\\\Terminal\\\\6278E353D77D4E501C6775ACEC85F415\\\\MQL4\"]}}}'; $lean|Set-Content $src -Encoding UTF8; $r=[PSCustomObject]@{cmd='cmd-light-cfg-001';label='backup-and-write-light-claude-desktop-config';status='done';ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ')}; $p='relay\from_cli.json'; $j=if(Test-Path $p){Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}else{[PSCustomObject]@{results=@();updated=''}}; if(-not $j.results){$j|Add-Member -NotePropertyName results -NotePropertyValue @() -Force}; $j.results+=$r; $j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ'); $j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content $p"
